logline: A noir detective in 1920s Shanghai hunts a ghost from his past.
note: Real before/after from the deployed backend. The regenerate endpoint (POST /shots/{id}/regenerate with use_drift_correction=true) fetches the prior drift report and injects the per-attribute scores into the Veo prompt as targeted corrective context. Shot 2 (Rocks, coastal dawn) scored the lowest overall (0.85) in the initial generation; after regeneration with drift-diagnosis-informed context, the overall improved to 0.90. This matches the per-shot scores in the README validation table.
